description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the IDGeneratorService component of the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to generating next IDs for various entities such as Employee, Location, JobCategory, etc., by mocking the IDGeneratorDao dependency and verifying the behavior of ID generation logic.

classes.name: IDGeneratorServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the IDGeneratorService logic, including ID incrementation and retrieval for various entity types.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the IDGeneratorService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetNextID
methods.description: Tests the getNextID method of IDGeneratorService to verify it generates the correct next ID based on current ID.

methods.name: getNextIDDataProvider
methods.description: Provides test data for different entity types and expected next ID values.

methods.name: testIncrementId
methods.description: Tests the incrementId method to ensure it correctly updates the ID for a given entity.
